title: What If a Nankai Trough Megaquake Hit Japan? The Odds Are High

scenes.text: What if the Nankai Trough megaquake hit Japan tonight? A government panel says the odds are already high.
They put the chance at 75 to 82 percent within the next 30 years.
In the worst case, a late-night winter quake could kill up to 298,000 people.
More than 200,000 of those deaths would come from the tsunami, which could top ten meters along the Pacific coast.
Up to 2.4 million buildings could be destroyed, and 12.3 million people forced to evacuate.
Economic damage: 292 trillion yen, over 40 percent of Japan's economy. Evacuating fast could cut tsunami deaths to about 90,000.
